verses.1: And he heard the words of the sons of Laban, who said, “Yaakov took away everything that belonged to our father. And from what our father had, he did all this work.”
verses.2: And Jacob saw a white face. But he saw that it wasn’t his face at all; it was someone else’s face.
verses.3: And the LORD said to Jacob, “Go back to the land of your fathers and to your mother’s house. I will be with you.”
verses.4: And Jacob sent for Rachel and Leah, the maids, to bring them back to him.
verses.5: And he said to them, “Look, I see the faces of your ancestors. They are not like me at all. They are like idols. But my father was with me.”
verses.6: And you shall know that I have served your father with all my strength.
verses.7: And my wages was taken from me. They changed my wages into ten times as much, but God did not give me anything bad to face.
verses.8: If it is said, “Your reward will be great, and all the sheep will give birth to many lambs,” then your reward will be great, and all the sheep will give birth to many lambs. And if it is said, “Your reward will be great, and all the sheep will give birth to many lambs,” then your reward will indeed be great, and all the sheep will give birth to many lambs.
verses.9: And God took away your ancestors’ possessions, and He gave them to me.
verses.10: And it happened that, during the time when the sheep were dying, I opened my eyes and saw in a dream. And there were those who were standing over the sheep, picking them up and cleaning them.
verses.11: And the angel of the Lord said to me in a dream, “Jacob, I am here.”
verses.12: And he said, “Open your eyes and see all those things that are rising up above the ground. They’re all covered in dust and dirt. For I have seen everything that is white being made for you.”
verses.13: I am the God of heaven. You have destroyed that place where I was placed. You have broken the covenant with me there. Now, get up from this land and return to the land where you were born.
verses.14: Rachel and Leah said to him, “Please give us a portion and inheritance in our father’s house.”
verses.15: We were not considered as goods to be sold; they ate all our money.
verses.16: For all that God has saved from our ancestors, it is for us and our children. Now, whatever God has commanded you to do, do it.
verses.17: And Jacob got up, and he put his sons and daughters on the donkeys.
verses.18: And he ruled over all his possessions and all his wealth that he had acquired from his ancestors. He bought these possessions in Padan Aram, so that he could come to his father Isaac’s land, Canaan.
verses.19: And Laban went to steal our inheritance. And Rachel stole the lambs that belonged to her father.
verses.20: And Jacob stole the white camel from Arma, without telling him that it was a stolen item.
verses.21: And he fled, along with all those who were with him. He got up and crossed the river. Then he covered his face with his hands.
verses.22: And on the third day, he told Laban that Jacob had died.
verses.23: And he took his brothers with him. He followed them for seven days, and then he brought them to Mount Gilgal.
verses.24: And God came to Laban in a dream that night. He said to him, “Keep your lips still, so that you won’t speak anything good about Jacob.”
verses.25: And Laban placed Jacob in a tent on the mountain. And Laban also placed his brothers in tents on the mountain Gilgal.
verses.26: And Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done? You have taken my beloved away from me, and you have treated my daughters like slaves.”
verses.27: Why did you dare to fly away and steal me from me? You didn’t even tell me anything. I will send you away with joy and triumph.
verses.28: And do not abandon me to cry for my children and my daughters now. You have become foolish.
verses.29: I have the power to do you harm. And your ancestors’ God will also harm you. He said to me, “Keep yourself away from what Yaakov said, both good and bad.”
verses.30: And now, go away! You have become like a thief who has stolen from your father’s house. Why did you steal my God?
verses.31: And Jacob said to Laban, “I will not do that. I won’t say anything if you don’t take away my daughters from me.”
verses.32: And when you find your God, he will not live against our brothers who have suffered for your sake. What happened to me and what you took away from me… Jacob won’t know that Rachael stole them from him.
verses.33: And he went into Jacob’s tent, and also into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of both sisters. But he didn’t find anything there. So he left Leah’s tent and went into Rahab’s tent.
verses.34: And Rachel took the tarps and placed them on the roof of the tent. Then she sat down on them. But she couldn’t find any white cloth to cover the entire tent.
verses.35: And she said to her father, “Do not be angry in Adonai’s eyes, for he cannot get up from before you. For it is women’s way to do this to me.” So he searched around, but he couldn’t find the bandages.
verses.36: And he cursed Jacob. He became angry with him. Then Jacob said to Laban, “What are my sins? What have I done to deserve this punishment from you?”
verses.37: For you have taken away everything from me. What did you find among all the things in your house? Put it here, so that my brothers and sisters can see it between us.
verses.38: For forty years, I have been with you, my beloved ones. You were not able to feed yourselves, and I did not eat from your offerings either.
verses.39: I have brought you no harm. I am innocent of any wrongdoing. Please do not accuse me of anything. I am free, both day and night.
verses.40: That day, I ate raw food and drank cold water at night. My eyes became blind from all this suffering.
verses.41: I have served you for forty years in your house. I also served your two daughters for twenty-five years. And for six years, I served your flock. My wages were exchanged with twelve months of service.
verses.42: O Lord, God of my father Abraham! The fear that Isaac felt was real. Now, You have sent me to solve my problems. When I see that God has heard my prayers, I will be relieved.
verses.43: And Laban said to Jacob, “These are my daughters, and the sons of my womb. The sheep and all that you see belong to me. What shall I do with these people today, or with their children who have been born?”
verses.44: And now, a covenant has been made between me and you. This covenant shall be a forever binding agreement between me and you.
verses.45: And Jacob took an ox, and set it up in a stand.
verses.46: And Jacob said to his brothers, “Take stones.” They took stones and made a altar. Then they ate there on the altar.
verses.47: And Laban called him Zophar. Jacob, on the other hand, was called Gadiel.
verses.48: And Laban said, “This plague has happened between me and you today. Therefore, let us call him Galleed.”
verses.49: And the prophet said, “YHWH will stand between me and you, because one person has been hidden from his enemies.”
verses.50: If you disobey your daughters, and if you take women as wives for your daughters, then no man will be with us. God will see this between me and you.
verses.51: And Laban said to Jacob, “Look here! This is the ground I have planted between us.”
verses.52: I am witness to this situation. If I do not pass on this message to you, and if you also do not pass on this message to me, then this situation will be bad for both of us.
verses.53: The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor will judge between us. The God of their ancestors will settle this matter. Jacob was terrified by his father Isaac’s presence.
verses.54: And Jacob offered sacrifices on the mountain. He called out to his brothers, “Eat some bread.” So they ate bread and feasted on the mountain.
